sentences.text:
B, Brahmandlapally Rama Rao, vs The State Of Telangana on 20
June, 2023
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice G. Anupama Chakravarthy
 Criminal Petition No.5406 of 2023

entities.text: B, Brahmandlapally Rama Rao, vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri S.Ganesh, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent No.1 and perused the record.

2. This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. by the petitioner/accused seeking to quash the proceedings in Crime No.6 of 2022 registered on the file of Station House Officer, Central Crime Station, Hyderabad, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 465, 467 and 471 IPC read with Section 34 IPC.
3.

It is to be noted that for the offence punishable under Section 467 IPC, the punishment which can be awarded is imprisonment for life or imprisonment for 10 years or fine and for the other offences mentioned above, the punishment prescribed is less than 7 years.

A reading of the complaint dated 21.10.2021 lodged by the respondent No.2 against the petitioner/accused indicates that there are civil disputes between the petitioner and the respondent No.2 and it was specifically mentioned therein that a gift settlement deed was given by the mother of the petitioner and the de facto complainant.
Therefore, this Court is of the prima facie view that the ingredients of the offence punishable under Section 467 IPC are not attracted.

5. In view of the above and since the punishment prescribed for the other offences i.e., Sections 465 and 471 IPC is less than seven years and Section 420 IPC may extend to seven years, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the petitioner to appear before the Investigating Officer on 04.07.2023 between 2:00 P.M. and 4:00 P.M.

The Investigating Officer shall follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A Cr.P.C. and also the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar vs. State of GAC, J Bihar1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar vs. State of GAC, J Bihar1 scrupulously
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, the petitioner shall cooperate with the Investigating Officer and furnish the information and documents as sought by him in concluding the investigation.
6. Accordingly, this Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
